abilities.name: Underway Ear
abilities.text: Once per round, before you resolve a movement or hazard test, inspect its target value before choosing Gear.

abilities.name: Black Dust Craft
abilities.text: After you pass a Forge test in a route, machine, or salvage sector, repair 1 exhausted Gear.

abilities.name: Lantern Delver
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Signal on anomaly-lit route tests.

abilities.name: Deep Bargain
abilities.text: Once per shop visit, when buying Equipment, you may pay 1 Salvage less. Weakness: Black Dust Craft cannot be used in shops.
